responsibility: Exercises the transitive relation module’s externally observable behavior by constructing sample relations and asserting reachability, minimal upper bound selection, parent computation, postdominating upper bounds, and handling of cycles and strongly connected components.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the lower-level graph storage and graph-algorithm test files, this one exercises the higher-level `TransitiveRelation` query semantics—reachability, minimal upper bounds, parent selection, and postdominating upper bounds—through relation-specific scenarios.
